verdict.rationale: GrowthBook lists a first-party 'Safe rollouts' feature on its Pro tier, and its rules docs tie automatic ramp-ups to safe rollouts; experiments also support guardrail metrics. However, nothing in the evidence describes how safe rollouts monitor metrics, detect a regression, or automatically roll a release back. Ramp-ups, guardrail metrics on experiments, and manual revision reverts are adjacent capabilities, not proof of metric-triggered automatic rollback. Missing for 10: documented metric-based regression detection on rollouts, documented automatic rollback/kill behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of safe rollouts.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically

citations.quote: a value-serving rule can [ramp up automatically](#ramp-ups-and-safe-rollouts) over time instead of switching on all at once.
